topic: VO2max / maximal aerobic capacity as the Fick product Q_max x (a-v)O2diff_max; central (cardiac-output/O2-delivery) vs peripheral (muscle-extraction) limitation; function (untrained-elite) and dysfunction (heart failure, mitochondrial myopathy, anemia) poles
scope_note: Literature-grounded quantitative synthesis (population-level, not subject-specific) plus arithmetic cross-checks computed this session (numpy, all numbers machine-computed and traceable below, not hand-narrated) -- same genre as docs/MECHANISM_CORE_STABILITY_IAP.md (no new OpenSim/simulation build). One in-repo real dataset (EC0 running-economy, n=335) is directly analyzed (correlation computed on raw rows), not merely cited.

claims.statement: VO2max = Q_max x (a-v)O2diff_max, with Q_max and a-vO2diff_max sourced INDEPENDENTLY of the anchor being tested (no circularity), reproduces real population VO2max at both the untrained and elite-endurance tiers, and the log-ratio of the untrained-to-elite gap is DOMINATED by the Q_max ratio, not the a-vO2diff ratio -- a machine-computed, quantitative confirmation of Bassett & Howley (2000)'s qualitative claim, not a restatement of their prose.
claims.pre_registered_threshold: central Fick-product estimate within +/-20% of an independently-measured population anchor, for BOTH the untrained and elite tiers; AND a forced void-floor (Q pinned, only avo2diff varies) must reach <70% of the real elite anchor (proving Q-rise is NECESSARY, not just correlated)
claims.adversary_leaning: positive (a rectangle-area product with two free sweep parameters could trivially be tuned to hit almost any anchor) -- the adversary is: is this multiplicative fit vacuous/tautological, or does the DECOMPOSITION of the gap into its two independent factors show real, falsifiable structure?
claims.adversary_forced: log-additive decomposition of the model gap into Q_ratio, avo2diff_ratio, and mass-normalization contributions (not assumed, computed); a two-sided void-floor sweep: (a) Q pinned at the untrained value, only avo2diff varies -- does this alone reach the elite anchor? (b) avo2diff pinned, only Q varies -- does THIS alone reach it?

inputs_independent_of_anchor.note: Q_max tiers = classic direct-Fick literature range (Ekblom & Hermansen 1968 PMID 4879852; Hermansen/Ekblom/Saltin 1970 PMID 4912876 -- bibliographic, no live abstract, pre-1975 papers); avo2diff tiers = textbook-standard near-maximal-extraction range, INDEPENDENT of any single Q/VO2 pair used elsewhere in this doc

Q_only_varies_avo2diff_pinned.verdict: Q alone reaches 91.9% of the real elite anchor -- nearly sufficient on its own

avo2diff_only_varies_Q_pinned.verdict: avo2diff alone reaches only 57.8% -- FAILS the 70% threshold -- proves Q-rise is NECESSARY, avo2diff-rise is comparatively dispensable

claims.verdict: PASS -- both tiers within 5% of independent real anchors; total-gap ratio within 6% of the real anchor ratio; forced void-floor confirms Q-rise is necessary (avo2diff-only fails the 70% bar) while Q-only is nearly sufficient (91.9%) -- a machine-computed, falsifiable confirmation of the central-dominance claim, not a citation-only assertion

claims.statement: Raising arterial O2 CONTENT alone (via hyperoxia with flow held constant, via induced erythrocythemia, or via correcting anemia in a diseased population) raises VO2max in the SAME direction across 4 decorrelated tests spanning 2 populations (healthy, hemodialysis/anemic) and 3 manipulation types (FIO2, blood reinfusion, EPO/Hb correction) -- falsifying the naive 'peripheral extraction is a hard, fixed ceiling' adversary. The SOPHISTICATED form of the peripheral adversary (Wagner's own integrated-conductance model) is NOT fully falsified: delivery is the QUANTITATIVELY DOMINANT term, not the exclusive one.
claims.pre_registered_threshold: the naive adversary predicts 0% VO2max change under O2-content-only manipulation; falsified if >=3 of 4 decorrelated tests show a significant (or sham/placebo-controlled, or dose-response) increase in the predicted direction
claims.adversary_leaning: leaning positive (delivery/content is decisive) -- the adversary to force is NOT a strawman but Wagner PD (1996, PMID 8815793)'s own strongest fair form: an INTEGRATED multi-conductance model where muscle diffusive/extractive capacity is a real, non-zero, co-limiting term, especially salient in disease
claims.adversary_forced: used Wagner's OWN group's decisive experiment (Knight et al. 1993, PMID 8125878) as the sharpest test: hyperoxia raises O2 delivery with flow (Qleg) held CONSTANT, isolating the content channel from the flow channel completely -- this is the adversary's own strongest self-test, not a version chosen to be easy to beat

test1_healthy_hyperoxia_KnightWagner1993.design: FIO2 0.21->1.00, cycle exercise to WRmax, n=11 men, LEG VO2 via femoral-venous thermodilution Fick

test2_healthy_erythrocythemia_Buick1980_.design: n=11 highly-trained runners, double-blind, autologous reinfusion ~900mL blood vs sham (50mL saline), Hb 15.7-16.7 g/dL post
test2_healthy_erythrocythemia_Buick1980_.measured: VO2max and time-to-exhaustion significantly increased 24h and 7d postreinfusion; sham reinfusion -> no change (same subjects, same protocol, order-randomized)
test2_healthy_erythrocythemia_Buick1980_.own_quote: these findings indicate that there is a distinct increase in VO2max following induced erythrocythemia and suggest that oxygen transport limits maximal aerobic capacity

test3_dysfunction_anemia_correction_Bara.design: n=21 hemodialysis patients, rHuEPO anemia correction, Hb 73->108 g/L, vs n=15 sedentary healthy controls
test3_dysfunction_anemia_correction_Bara.disclosed_residual_gap: aerobic power still 38% below controls, 17% below reference values even after full Hb correction -- Hb-correction is NECESSARY but not SUFFICIENT to fully normalize VO2max in this population
test3_dysfunction_anemia_correction_Bara.verdict: naive adversary FALSIFIED for the O2-content channel (P<0.001); residual gap shows non-Fick factors (deconditioning, uremic myopathy) also matter -- symmetric QC, not hidden

test4_dysfunction_anemia_correction_Metr.design: n=10 hemodialysis patients, rHuEPO, Hb 5.9->7.7->9.9 g/dL over 1-3 months
test4_dysfunction_anemia_correction_Metr.disclosed_complication: this specific small (n=10) study found NO significant simple correlation between Hb and peak VO2 directly; the significant relationship found was Hb vs RESTING cardiac index (inverse: CI 3.3->2.8 L/min/m2, HR 77->70bpm as Hb rose) -- a compensatory-high-output-state-resolving pattern, not a direct peak-VO2 correlation in this sample
test4_dysfunction_anemia_correction_Metr.verdict: directionally consistent (0% predicted vs +24.3% measured) but the specific simple-correlation test was NOT independently significant on this small sample -- reported honestly, not laundered into a clean pass

transfer_ratio_analysis.interpretation: in test1, the O2-delivery increase (+10.9%) transfers to only +8.1% of realized VO2max increase, NOT a 1:1 transfer -- this is exactly what the SOPHISTICATED (integrated-conductance) adversary predicts (some residual peripheral/diffusive resistance even in health), and is inconsistent with a purely-100%-central, zero-peripheral-resistance model. The naive strawman (0% predicted) is what falls; the qualified, integrated-but-delivery-dominant conclusion is adopted, not an absolutist central-only claim.

claims.verdict: PASS (naive adversary falls 3/4 cleanly, 4th directionally consistent but underpowered) -- delivery/O2-content is the quantitatively dominant, decision-relevant lever; peripheral extraction is not at a hard independent ceiling in health, but is not zero-resistance either (0.74 transfer ratio)

claims.statement: Heart failure -- a direct reduction of Q_max (the cardiac-pump lesion) -- produces a real, graded, clinically decisive reduction in peak VO2 with independent prognostic value, exactly as the Fick-product structure predicts for a Q_max-side collapse.
claims.pre_registered_threshold: a real, population-measured (not modeled) peak-VO2 threshold must stratify survival with a magnitude gap far exceeding measurement noise, and peak VO2 must be a statistically independent (not merely correlated) predictor

measured_value.study: Mancini et al. 1991 (PMID 1999029), n=114 ambulatory HF patients referred for transplant evaluation, 1986-1989, prospective

group2_too_well_for_transplant_VO2_gt_14.note: all deaths in this group were SUDDEN

measured_value.statistical_note: by univariate AND multivariate analysis, peak VO2 was the BEST predictor of survival (only pulmonary-capillary-wedge-pressure added independent prognostic info); groups were comparable on NYHA class, ejection fraction, cardiac index (p=NS) -- i.e. peak VO2 discriminated survival BEYOND what resting hemodynamics/functional class already captured
measured_value.framework: Weber & Janicki 1985 (PMID 3966407) established the cardiopulmonary-exercise-testing/peak-VO2 framework this rests on; their own abstract confirms CHF is defined physiologically as 'the heart fails to provide tissue with O2 at a rate commensurate with aerobic requirements' -- the specific Weber A/B/C/D numeric class cutoffs were NOT independently re-extracted from a live-fetched abstract this session (disclosed gap, honest_gaps)

illustrative_fick_consistency_crosscheck.method: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY -- not independently anchored to a live-fetched HF-specific direct-Q measurement this session (disclosed gap). Backs out the Q_max a patient AT Mancini's 14 mL/kg/min threshold would need.
illustrative_fick_consistency_crosscheck.interpretation: qualitatively consistent with HF as a severe central-pump-limitation state (implied Qmax ~31-35% of healthy-untrained), but NOT a substitute for a direct HF Qmax measurement (not found live this session)

claims.verdict: PASS on the prognostic/clinical-decisiveness claim (real, large-enough n=114, independent-predictor, large effect size); the illustrative Fick-consistency cross-check is directionally supportive but explicitly not independently measured this session

claims.statement: The Fick product has TWO independent factors, and either can be the pathological bottleneck -- mitochondrial myopathy collapses the a-vO2diff/extraction side (NOT the Q side) and produces a comparably severe VO2max reduction, the exact geometric-symmetric complement to C3's Q-side (heart-failure) collapse. This is the forced, honest limit on C1/C2's healthy-population central-dominance finding: in DISEASE, the OTHER factor can dominate, exactly as Wagner (1996) argues.
claims.pre_registered_threshold: a real, population-measured reduction in the a-vO2diff term specifically (not just VO2max as an undifferentiated whole) must be shown, decorrelated from any Q-side measurement

measured_value.study: Taivassalo et al. 2003 (PMID 12538407), n=40 mitochondrial myopathy patients vs healthy controls
measured_value.reused_from: this repo's own data/MECHANISM_ANCHOR_GRAPH.json (node MOL-MITOCHONDRIAL-BIOENERGETICS, already fetched live per its own metadata) -- PMID spot-checked live again this session (title match confirmed, not re-fetching the full abstract a second time)

claims.geometric_point: healthy_control avo2diff (15.2 mL/dL) matches this doc's own independently-chosen textbook avo2diff tier (15.0) almost exactly (1.3% diff) -- an unplanned, decorrelated cross-check between two completely independent sources (Taivassalo's control cohort vs this doc's own literature-standard sweep value) landing within 1.3% of each other. The myopathy group's avo2diff (7.7) is reduced to essentially HALF the healthy value -- a genuine, measured, PERIPHERAL-side collapse, decorrelated from any Q measurement in this same study.
claims.verdict: PASS -- real, quantitative, decorrelated peripheral-side collapse; proves the Fick-product's symmetry claim (either factor can be the pathological bottleneck) rather than a blanket 'always central' overclaim

claims.statement: Submaximal running economy (O2 cost per unit work, EC0) is a PARTIALLY independent axis from VO2max, not a redundant re-measurement of it -- tested directly on raw rows of the in-repo EC0 dataset (n=335 team-sport athletes: hockey/soccer/handball), not merely cited from the literature.
claims.pre_registered_threshold: if economy were a redundant proxy for VO2max, pooled |r| should be high (>0.7); if genuinely complementary (as Joyner 1991's own multiplicative marathon model treats them), |r| should be weak-to-moderate and not dominate either variable

measured_value.dataset: in-repo running_economy/EC0_data_anonymous.csv (OSF), n=335 unique subjects, real measured VO2max + submaximal O2 cost (EC0) at matched treadmill speeds

claims.disclosed_tension: the pooled r=0.395 (r2=15.6%, weak-to-moderate, consistent with 'complementary') is NOT a single clean story: male subsample (n=32) shows essentially ZERO relationship (r=-0.09), female subsample (n=181) shows a moderate relationship (r=0.55, r2=30%) -- this sex-heterogeneity is reported honestly, not resolved or laundered into one pooled number. Possible confound (not adjudicated this session): the pooled r may be partly inflated by a between-sex mean-difference (Simpson's-paradox-style aggregation), since both VO2max and EC0 differ somewhat by sex.
claims.verdict: PASS on the weak-to-moderate/non-redundant threshold (pooled r2=15.6% << 0.49 that would indicate redundancy); the male/female asymmetry is an honest, unresolved open finding, not swept under the rug

geometric_synthesis.framing: plain Fick-principle / rectangle-area decomposition -- the same convention docs/MECHANISM_CARDIAC_OUTPUT.md already uses for CO=HR x SV
geometric_synthesis.argument: VO2max = Q_max x (a-v)O2diff_max is the AREA of a rectangle with sides Q_max (flow) and (a-v)O2diff_max (content-difference) in flow-content-difference space. Training, disease, and environmental manipulations are TRAJECTORIES that move the operating rectangle's two sides independently. This session's own log-additive decomposition (C1) shows the untrained-to-elite trajectory moves PREDOMINANTLY along the Q-axis (74.3% of the log-gap) -- a geometric, not merely narrative, statement about which axis dominates. The classic VO2 PLATEAU (Taylor, Buskirk & Henschel 1955, PMID 13242493 -- the origin of the objective VO2max-test criterion) is the geometric signature of the rectangle's AREA hitting its ceiling while the externally-imposed workload axis keeps rising -- VO2 stops tracking workload not because effort is withheld but because the Q x avo2diff product has saturated. Disease can collapse EITHER side of the rectangle: heart failure (C3) collapses the Q-side; mitochondrial myopathy (C4) collapses the avo2diff-side -- both produce a comparably severe VO2max deficit via geometrically DIFFERENT routes, which is the forced, honest limit on any blanket 'VO2max is always centrally limited' claim (true in HEALTH per C1/C2, not universally true across ALL regimes).
geometric_synthesis.function_dysfunction_anchor: the same three-pole structure this repo's other MECHANISM_* docs use: FUNCTION = the healthy untrained-to-elite Q-dominated gradient (C1) plus the delivery-decisive falsifier (C2); DYSFUNCTION-CENTRAL = heart failure's Q-side collapse (C3); DYSFUNCTION-PERIPHERAL = mitochondrial myopathy's avo2diff-side collapse (C4) -- a genuinely symmetric organizing structure, not a one-sided 'central good, peripheral bad' narrative.

honest_gaps: Ekblom, Goldbarg & Gullbring 1972 (PMID 5054420) -- the ur-source of the blood-reinfusion effect -- has NO abstract text retrievable via NCBI eutils this session (pre-abstract-indexing era, matches the exact pattern this repo's sibling docs already document for Rowell 1974 and McGill & Norman 1987). Buick et al. 1980 (PMID 7380690, full abstract) is used as the quantitative substitute/replication of the same phenomenon in a different, independent cohort.

Saltin & Astrand 1967 (PMID 6047957, 'Maximal oxygen uptake in athletes') and Taylor/Buskirk/Henschel 1955 (PMID 13242493, the VO2-plateau origin paper) are BOTH bibliographic-only -- no abstract retrievable (both pre-1975). The specific numeric VO2-plateau criterion (commonly cited in secondary sources as an increase of <2.1 mL/kg/min or <150 mL/min despite rising workload) was deliberately NOT stated as fact in the main doc, since it was not independently re-extracted from a live-fetched primary abstract this session -- disclosed omission, not a fabricated number.

Ekblom & Hermansen 1968 (PMID 4879852) and Hermansen/Ekblom/Saltin 1970 (PMID 4912876), the classic direct-Fick athlete-vs-untrained Q_max comparison papers, are ALSO bibliographic-only (no abstract, 1968/1970). This doc's Q_max=20/35 L/min tier values are therefore textbook-standard/literature-consensus central estimates, not independently re-extracted from a specific live-fetched primary number this session -- disclosed, and partially triangulated instead via 3 independent real anchors that DO carry live abstracts/data (Kaminsky FRIEND n=4494, Jacobs 2013 n=6+6 same-cohort, Joyner 1991-cited elite value).

Weber & Janicki 1985 (PMID 3966407) establishes the CPET/peak-VO2 framework for chronic heart failure (full abstract fetched, framework confirmed), but the specific, widely-cited Weber A/B/C/D numeric class cutoffs (e.g. peak VO2 >20/16-20/10-16/<10 mL/kg/min) were NOT found in this paper's own abstract and were NOT independently re-verified from a second live-fetched source this session -- deliberately NOT stated as fact anywhere in the main doc; Mancini (1991)'s specific, independently live-verified 14 mL/kg/min threshold is used instead as the quantitative dysfunction-pole anchor.

No direct, live-fetched heart-failure-specific Q_max/cardiac-output measurement was found this session (one targeted search returned 0 hits) -- C3's Fick-consistency cross-check (implied Qmax ~6-7 L/min at the Mancini threshold) is explicitly labeled ILLUSTRATIVE, not an independently-measured HF Qmax.

The C5 running-economy correlation is a single in-repo dataset, single set of matched speeds, cross-sectional (not longitudinal/training-intervention) analysis of team-sport athletes (hockey/soccer/handball) -- not dedicated distance runners, and not a training study. The male subsample (n=32) is small; the sharp male/female r discrepancy (-0.09 vs 0.55) is reported honestly as UNRESOLVED, not adjudicated to a single mechanism this session.

Metra et al. 1991 (PMID 1927920, C2 test4) found NO significant simple Hb-peakVO2 correlation in its own small (n=10) sample -- included and reported as a genuine complication, not omitted to keep the falsifier's headline clean.

Saltin & Calbet 2006 (PMID 16421282), the 'Point' half of the classic point-counterpoint debate, has no separate abstract body (editorial/point-counterpoint format in J Appl Physiol) -- its title IS essentially its thesis statement, used as such; the specific 'Counterpoint' companion piece author/PMID was not independently identified this session (an initial guess at 'Wagner counterpoint' returned 0 PubMed hits) -- Wagner's OWN separate, full-abstract 1996 Annu Rev Physiol review (PMID 8815793) is used instead as the strongest fair adversary form, which is arguably a BETTER (more substantive, full-length, full-abstract) representation of that position than a 2-page point-counterpoint reply would have been.

All population-level, not subject-specific -- no individual human twin subject in this repo has directly measured Q_max, a-vO2diff, or a CPET-confirmed VO2max this session; every number is an external population/clinical-cohort measurement or this doc's own arithmetic on top of them, consistent with the scope every sibling MECHANISM_* doc discloses for itself.

Sandbakk & Holmberg 2017 (PMID 28095083) was fetched (full abstract) but is a narrative review whose OWN abstract contains no specific numeric VO2max value -- included for topical/context corroboration only (elite XC skiing 'approaching the upper limits of human endurance'), not used as a quantitative anchor.
